about: Programs, calls and the answers every host-logic engine must give for them: the browser's (assets/host-logic/engine.mjs, scripts/ui-builder-web-smoke/host-logic-engine.test.mjs) and the JVM's (ui-builder-runtime, HostLogicParityTest). An answer is either `result`, compared as JSON, or `error`, a substring of the message: the two QuickJS builds word some interpreter errors differently, and the substring is what both say. docs/design/UI_BUILDER_HOST_LOGIC.md.

cases.name: a reducer answers each action from the state it is handed
every way of reading the time reads the design's clock
randomness is the seeded sequence
cases.source:
export function init() { return [Math.random(), Math.random()]; }
export function onAction() {}

cases.name: what a program throws is said the same way

calls.error: host logic threw an object that is not an Error

cases.name: a program missing an export does not load
cases.loadError: host logic must export a function named onAction

cases.name: a program's own top-level names do not collide with the engine's checks
a program that declares its functions without exporting them does not load
cases.source:
function init() { return {}; }
function onAction() { return {}; }
cases.loadError: host logic must export a function named init

cases.name: a program that is not JavaScript does not load
a call that runs forever is interrupted
cases.source:
export function init() { for (;;) {} }
export function onAction() { return { values: {} }; }
